scope: Warm development ASR comparison on Apple M4/32 GiB, one seed, 118 exposed clips per arm. No held-out or release claim.
timing: Shared desktop, not thermally/energy isolated. The original pre-envelope run overlapped validation and later probes. The fresh comparison had no competing model run; brief code/report preparation and targeted checks occurred during its baseline block. No slow observations were excluded.
window: 36 actual paired reads on owned AppKit fixtures, 24 fixed-source rewrites and 24 stopped-audio/context rewrites. Earlier stable-recognition evidence, live preview and insertion are not replayed.
privacy: Local native inference and offline provisioning; no separate firewall/air-gap experiment.
lineage: Community ONNX INT8 export; original floating-point parity unverified.
metadataCorrection: The original catalog snapshot recorded 10:04:52Z for the export timestamp; final catalog corrects it to metadata-derived 09:44:52Z. Payload revisions and digests are identical.
